title: How One Phone Call Wiped Out $9 Billion
alt_titles: From Pizza Shop to Private Island to Zero

segments.text: In 2008, a single phone call wiped out nine billion dollars in value in less than a week. Nobody at the company saw it coming, not even the founder.

To understand how this happened, we need to go back twenty years, to a tiny office above a pizza shop, where two friends had an idea that everyone told them was stupid. But that was not the worst part.

Within five years, the company was worth more than its three biggest rivals combined. Investors were lining up, and the founder bought a private island. What do you think went wrong? Tell me in the comments.
